title: Winding Road
intro: Follow the road wherever it bends. Going straight when you can, and otherwise turning the way the road goes, works on every one of these maps.
cs_note: [b]Nested conditionals[/b] form a decision tree: can I go straight? If not, can I go left? Every leaf of the tree needs an action, or the robot freezes.
hints: When the way ahead is blocked, there is exactly one open side.
if path_ahead(): move(), else check path_left() to choose which way to turn.

Inside while not at_exit(), put an if … else on path_ahead() with move() in its first mouth. In its else mouth, put a second if … else on path_left(): turn_left() first, turn_right() in its else. A turn doesn't move the robot; the next pass of the loop walks the new way.
